arabic text: ZINDAGI BHAR TADAPTA RAHA ISHQ ME APNE MAULA KA DEEDAR\nKAR NA SAKA\nJAB HUI HAI MERI SAANSE SUE LAHAD
english translation text: Throughout my life I yearned in love,\nyet could not behold my Maula. Now\nthat my breaths turn towards the grave...

arabic text: MAI DUA DU LAHAD SE MUJHE UTHA LE CHALO
english translation text: I will pray from within the grave: lift me from here and take me with you.

arabic text:
APNE MAULA KE KADMO KO CHUMUNGA MAI
FARSH SE ARSH KOH AAJ CHUMUNGA MAI
YEH IBADAT KOH HARGIZ NA BHULUNGA MAI
TUMKO ALLAH KA WASTA LE CHALO
english translation text:
I will kiss my Maula's feet;
today I will kiss the Throne through the earth.
I will never forget this worship.
For Allah's sake, take me with you.

arabic text:
HAQ ADAAI HU MAI TUMKO MAALUM HAI
EK FIDAAI HU MAI TUMKO MALUM HAI
KARBALAAI HU MAI TUMKO MALUM HAI
MERI MAYYAT YAHA SE UTHA LE CHALO

YEH LAHAD TOH NAHI HAI THIKANA MERA
YAANI HAI AB WAHI AAB DAANA MERA
BAN GAYA HAI WAHI AASHYANA MERA
YAA NAJAF MUJHKO YA NAINAVA LE CHALO

SAR KE BAL AAJ CHALTA HUA AA JAUGA
HAI IRAADA YAHI SAMARRAH JAUGA
MAI KHURASAN NAJAF KARBALA JAAUNGA
KHULD JAHA HAI MUJHE US JAGAH LE CHALO

ALLAH ALLAH GAAZI KA ROBO HASHAM
SEENAE AAB PAR USNE GAARDA ALAM
SOCHA SAHIL PE YEH BEHRE AHLE HARAM
DOSH PAR RAKHKE YEH ALQAMA LE CHALO
english translation text:
Allah, Allah—the majesty and dignity of Ghazi!
He planted the standard upon the river's chest.
For the sake of the sacred family, he thought upon the shore:
lift the Alqama itself upon your shoulders and carry it.

arabic text:
AI ABAD MERI JANNAT HAI KARBOBALA
MERI MATTI ME HAI ISHQE AALE IBAA
KUCH NAI CHAYE MUJHKO USKE SIWAA
SUE DAAMANE AHLE KISA LE CHALO
